field.title: Built for the water, not the office

items.title: Works offline
items.body: Trips, manifests and safety checks save on the phone and sync when the signal returns.

items.title: Voice notes count
items.body: “Trip four, CMS to Ikorodu, eighteen passengers” becomes a logged trip after one tap.

items.title: Any phone
items.body: Light enough for a low-cost Android on a slow network, readable in full sun.

items.a: It helps, but it isn’t required. Captains can log trips by WhatsApp voice note or by a short SMS, and the office can enter trips for them.

items.q: What happens when there’s no signal on the water?
items.a: Captain screens work offline. Trips, manifests and safety checks are saved on the phone and sync automatically when the connection returns.

items.q: Can a captain override the safety lock?
items.a: No. A blocked trip can only depart with the owner’s recorded approval, and an overloaded boat can’t depart at all.
Online by card, transfer or USSD, or in cash at the jetty. Every ticket gets a code the crew scans at boarding.

items.q: Is passenger and crew data safe?
items.a: Data is encrypted, each company only sees its own records, and we follow the data-protection law of every country we operate in.
We’re launching in Nigeria with Lagos ferry operators and offshore support vessels. Other countries follow as we validate each market.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: Tideline helps boat and vessel operators run trips, keep passenger manifests, manage documents and handle charters. This notice explains what we collect, why, where it is kept and your rights.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: Account: your name, phone number, language and time zone. Passengers: name and number of seats; a phone number and next-of-kin number only when the operator or regulator needs them. Crew: name, role, phone and certificates. Trips: departure and arrival times, safety checks and, while a trip is running, the vessel’s position. Payments: amounts and references; card and bank details are handled by the payment provider, and we keep only the last 4 digits of payout accounts. Documents you upload, and messages you send to our WhatsApp assistant.

sections.title: Why we use it
sections.body: To provide the service you or your operator signed up for (contract); to keep passengers safe and meet maritime rules: passenger manifests are collected for passenger safety (legal obligation and vital interests); to prevent fraud and abuse and improve the service (legitimate interests); and, only if you agree, to send you offers (consent, which you can withdraw at any time).

sections.title: Who we share it with
sections.body: Your operator or charter counterparty, as the service needs. Service providers who process data for us under contract (see the processor list), and authorities where the law requires. We do not sell personal data. AI features receive only the minimum data needed, and a person checks AI output before it counts.

sections.title: Where it is kept
sections.body: Data is stored with our database host in the region shown below, and some providers process it in other countries (see the processor list). Transfers outside your country are made only under a lawful basis, such as adequate protection or contractual safeguards.

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.body: Passenger manifests and trip positions: {months} months, then names and numbers are removed and positions deleted. Documents: while the account is active, then for a set period. Payment and invoice records: as long as tax and accounting law requires. Audit records of safety decisions are kept without personal details.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can ask for a copy of your data, ask us to correct or delete it, object to some uses, and withdraw consent. Signed in, go to Settings → Privacy; we answer within 30 days. Deletion can’t remove records the law requires us to keep, but your details are taken out of them. You can also complain to your data protection authority (in Nigeria, the Nigeria Data Protection Commission).

sections.title: Security
sections.body: Encrypted connections everywhere, encryption at rest, private file storage with short-lived links, strict access rules per company, and an audit trail of changes. Staff access to passenger data needs a recorded reason.

privacy.hostingUnset: Database hosting: to be confirmed before launch.
privacy.requestLink: Ask for your data or deletion

terms.intro: These short terms sit alongside your subscription or charter agreement.

sections.title: The safety lock supports, it does not replace
sections.body: Tideline’s safety lock checks weather, daylight, passenger numbers, life jackets and certificates before departure. It supports, and does not replace, the captain’s and owner’s responsibility for safe operation. Every override records who approved it and why.

sections.title: AI output is checked by a person
sections.body: Dates read from documents, drafted invoices, tender sections and price suggestions are proposals until a person confirms them.

sections.title: Payments
sections.body: Payments are processed by licensed providers. Escrow, where offered, is held and released under the rules shown on the charter page.

sections.title: Your data
sections.body: How we handle personal data is set out in the privacy notice.

settingsPrivacy.title: Privacy
settingsPrivacy.subtitle: Your choices and your data.
settingsPrivacy.marketingHint: Optional. You can change this any time.
settingsPrivacy.export: Get a copy of my data
settingsPrivacy.exportHint: We prepare a file with everything we hold about you, within 30 days.
settingsPrivacy.deleteHint: Your name and number are removed from trips, tickets and records. Payment and safety records the law requires stay, without your details. If you are the only owner of a company, hand it over first.
settingsPrivacy.confirmDelete: I understand this can’t be undone

requested.export: Request received. We’ll prepare your file within 30 days.
requested.delete: Request received. We’ll delete your account within 30 days.

notes.sole_owner: You’re the only owner of a company. Hand ownership to someone else first.

settingsPrivacy.sessionsHint: Lost a phone? Sign out on every device at once.

documents.title: Document review
documents.subtitle: Documents waiting for review where the reader was unsure (confidence under 80%), across all companies.

escrow.title: Escrow holds
escrow.subtitle: All holds, newest first. Disputes are resolved under Escrow disputes.

fees.title: Fees
fees.subtitle: Each change adds a row from its start date, so history is kept. Values are basis points (100 = 1%).

jetties.title: Jetties
jetties.subtitle: Jetties proposed by operators appear here for approval.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Latest 200 changes. Personal details are not shown here; changed fields are listed by name.

flags.title: Feature flags
flags.subtitle: Switch features on or off for everyone. Every change is audited.
flags.envNote: In production, escrow also needs ESCROW_ENABLED=on (legal sign-off).

privacy.title: Privacy requests
privacy.subtitle: Export and deletion requests, due within 30 days. Overdue requests are reported every morning.

passengers.title: Passenger data
passengers.subtitle: Opening a manifest needs a reason. Every read is recorded with your name and reason.
passengers.reasonHint: At least 10 characters, e.g. “Police request ref 123 about missing passenger”.
